title: Ouran High School Host Club
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Haruhi Fujioka, a scholarship student at elite Ouran Academy, breaks an ¥8,000,000 vase and must work off the debt for the Host Club, six rich boys who entertain female classmates. Mistaken for a boy, she becomes a host herself. The comedy parodies romance and boys' love tropes while poking at class privilege through Haruhi's 'commoner' eyes.
life_message: It holds up being true to oneself regardless of class or gender expectations, and the friendship that grows from honesty.
